_note: Wiretap scripts for the demo seed, pre-rendered by `python -m voice.prerender`. /wiretap uses these when /agents has no wiretap(); key is 'a|b' in either order.

ostrava|zarnia.speaker: ostrava
ostrava|zarnia.text: Valdoria promised me the berth for the whole day. What did they promise you?

ostrava|zarnia.speaker: zarnia
ostrava|zarnia.text: The same berth, General. They are selling it twice.

ostrava|zarnia.speaker: ostrava
ostrava|zarnia.text: Then the strait closes at dusk, and they can explain that to their voters.

kessaria|ostrava.speaker: kessaria
kessaria|ostrava.text: The port is mine to assign, General, not Valdoria's to promise.

kessaria|ostrava.speaker: ostrava
kessaria|ostrava.text: Then assign it to the nation with three days of bread left.

kessaria|nordhaven.speaker: nordhaven
kessaria|nordhaven.text: My tugs could open a second berth by nightfall, if anyone asked nicely.

kessaria|nordhaven.speaker: kessaria
kessaria|nordhaven.text: Then I am asking. Nicely, for now.
